description: This file defines a React functional component 'CacheSettings' that manages Redis cache configuration settings within a web UI. It includes state management, data fetching, form handling, and user interactions such as testing and saving cache settings, along with rendering various form fields and sections based on cache type.

methods.name: CacheSettings
methods.description: React functional component for managing cache settings UI, handling data loading, user interactions for testing and saving configs, and rendering form fields.

methods.name: loadCacheSettings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch current cache settings from backend and update component state.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Function to trigger a test connection to the cache server with current form values, providing user notifications based on success or failure.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Function to save the updated cache settings to the backend and reload the current settings, with user notifications.
